description: This file contains a set of shell script tests designed for verifying git hooks related to pre-commit and pre-merge-commit functionalities. It defines test scenarios for hooks that succeed or fail, handling non-executable hooks, hooks requiring specific environment variables like GIT_PREFIX or GIT_AUTHOR, and scenarios with the --no-verify option.

methods.name: setup_success_hook
methods.description: Sets up a successful hook script with the provided name and expected output.

methods.name: setup_failing_hook
methods.description: Sets up a failing hook script that exits with a non-zero status.

methods.name: setup_non_exec_hook
methods.description: Creates a hook script that is non-executable to test handling of permission issues.

methods.name: setup_require_prefix_hook
methods.description: Creates a hook that requires GIT_PREFIX to be set to a specific value.

methods.name: setup_require_author_hook
methods.description: Creates a hook that checks for specific author environment variables.
